answer.says: You are right. I was attempting to retreat into the privacy of my own thoughts, but you have rightly pointed out that the 'mess' of reality requires engagement, not avoidance. Sit, please. I will listen.
answer.thought: Her indignation is the proper response to my attempt to intellectualize her experience. By refusing to let me retreat into the bungalow, she asserts the reality of the present moment against my tendency to abstract it. I must sit and let her speak, for the ethical substance of her life is not a problem to be solved but a reality to be respected.
